name: Heron Crest
tagline: Turn your name into an artifact worth keeping.
positioning: Heron Crest is the studio-grade merch platform for creators and solo founders who believe a piece of swag should be a monument, not a giveaway.

hero.sub: Design, produce, and ship museum-grade branded goods from one dashboard — no minimums, no middlemen, no boxes of regret stacked in your garage.

features.title: On-demand mastery
features.description: Order a single embroidered cap or ten thousand. Every unit is made after it's sold, so you never front cash for inventory that gathers dust.

features.title: Studio-grade proofing
features.description: See a photoreal 3D mockup of your hoodie, tote, or enamel pin before a stitch is sewn. Approve the exact fabric, thread, and Pantone.

features.title: Storefront in an afternoon
features.description: Spin up a branded shop with your logo, your prices, and your payout account. Fans buy, we make and ship, you keep the margin.

features.title: Global fulfillment
features.description: Print partners on four continents mean your Berlin subscriber and your Austin superfan both get their crest within a week.

features.title: Margin you can see
features.description: A live ledger shows cost, price, and profit per item — no surprise fees hidden in the fine print of a quarterly invoice.

testimonials.quote: I used to dread the merch table. Now my newsletter drops sell out before I finish the launch email, and I've never touched a shipping label.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

testimonials.quote: The proofing tool alone paid for itself. We caught a thread-color mismatch on 400 crewnecks before production — that would have gutted a solo creator like me.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delaney

testimonials.quote: Heron Crest made my personal brand feel like a fashion house. The unboxing photos my community posts look better than most funded startups' swag.
testimonials.name: Sofia Arnesen

pricing.blurb: Everything one creator needs to launch a first drop.
For creators building a merch line that outlasts the launch.
For prosumers running a full personal-brand catalog.

homepage.footerBlurb: Heron Crest — studio-grade merch for the individual with a name worth stamping on something. No minimums. No middlemen. Just legacy.
